data.title: Elea
data.about:
Elea at The Valley by Emaar Properties introduces a new standard of living with its spacious 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses, designed to offer unparalleled comfort and sophistication. These large-sized homes feature contemporary layouts, open living spaces, and modern finishes, catering to families seeking a balance of elegance and functionality. Nestled in a tranquil community, Elea offers a serene escape from the city's hustle while providing a vibrant and family-friendly environment.

As part of The Valley, Elea residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, including lush parks, recreational areas, sports facilities, and retail options, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle. The development’s prime location along Dubai-Al Ain Road offers seamless connectivity to major landmarks, making it an ideal choice for families and investors. With flexible payment plans and Emaar’s trusted reputation, Elea at The Valley presents an exceptional opportunity to own a home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

characteristics_module.title: Welcome to Elea at The Valley by Emaar Properties
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Spacious Townhouses: Large-sized 3 and 4-bedroom homes designed for modern family living.
  • Tranquil Location: Nestled in a serene community, offering a peaceful escape from the city’s hustle.
  • World-Class Amenities: Access to parks, sports courts, playgrounds, and retail outlets for a vibrant lifestyle.
  • Renowned Developer: Developed by Emaar Properties, ensuring quality and trust.
  • Prime Connectivity: Strategically located along Dubai-Al Ain Road with easy access to major landmarks.
  • Family-Friendly Environment: Community-centered design with lush green spaces and recreational facilities.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: Investor-friendly options making homeownership more accessible.

image.name: Elea at The Valley by Emaar Properties

location_tile.title: The Valley: Where Tranquility Meets Modern Living
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Valley’s tranquil setting, surrounded by lush greenery and open spaces, offers residents a serene environment that feels worlds away from the city’s hustle. Despite its peaceful atmosphere, the area is rapidly developing into a thriving community with state-of-the-art amenities, schools, healthcare facilities, and retail outlets. 
The combination of accessibility, natural surroundings, and world-class infrastructure makes Elea at The Valley an exceptional location for families and investors alike, promising a lifestyle that blends convenience with comfort.

  • Dubai Outlet Mall: 10 minutes
  • Global Village: 20 minutes
  • IMG Worlds of Adventure: 25 minutes
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis: 20 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai: 25 minutes
